Leah (CEO): Live thread for the Q&A follow-ups: we need crisp signals on why we won/lost and the one next action for each. Keep it short.

Mira (Sales): Field summary: wins = retail + adtech (latency + cost clarity). Losses = regulated sectors (BYOK, retention, audit depth).

Ethan (Solutions): Add: migrations succeed when we provide a clear staging playbook + example cost delta. Customers liked our batching + prefix caching example.

Priya (Product): Proposed priorities (30d): 1) migration playbook template 2) BYOK scoping doc 3) 1-page "security & SLA" for procurement. Which one is highest?

Mira (Sales): BYOK scoping highest for closing Fin/Gov deals. Migration playbook next.

Jorge (Eng): I can scope BYOK (KMS vs HSM) and region pinning. Need decision: tiered retention as paid add-on? That affects design.

Asha (CS): CS asks: please produce a redacted SOC2 evidence bundle and a 1-page audit-ready checklist we can hand to customers.

ops-bot: New ticket created: PROD-5020 "BYOK + audit retention scoping" assigned to Jorge. Link: https://redwood.internal/t/PROD-5020

Leah (CEO): Owners: Jorge -> PROD-5020; Priya -> migration playbook + one-pager; Asha + Mira -> collect SOC2 examples. Targets: rough estimates in 5 business days.

Ethan (Solutions): I'll draft a 2-line "why we won" blurb for reps: 1) "Reduced token cost ~30% with batching+cache" 2) "Consistent p95 < 300ms with route pinning." Posting in Sales Kit.

Leah (CEO): Thanks team. Add any other procurement redlines here and tag owners if you need a sync. Closing after estimates are in. :white_check_mark:
